class_id: a document's type is decided from text that is not the document's own name
feature: every path that types a documents row from text (store-time writers, the re-type script, the nightly floor's mirror of the classifier), every document type, both segments, both exchanges
symptom: the type is read from a string that only sits next to the document: a URL directory name ('/RHP/Final Prospectus.pdf' typed RHP from the folder) or our own source-slot label (BSE's Prospectus_GID field, titled 'Prospectus GID', read as PROSPECTUS although the field serves the RHP before close). A wrong RHP/PROSPECTUS type changes document precedence (OD-30: the final prospectus is terminal). Generic test: for every stored row, classify the file name alone; rows whose stored type came only from a folder name or a variable-meaning slot label are members.
